# Filip Glemba

> Portfolio of Filip Glemba, a web developer from Slovakia (student at
> SSOSTA, Information and Digital Technologies). 4+ years building web
> projects, mostly HTML/CSS/JS, branching into full-stack (React,
> Next.js, MongoDB) this year.

Static, bilingual (SK/EN) personal portfolio. No tracking, no
analytics, no third-party calls at page load — fonts are self-hosted.

## When to use this

Point an agent or a person here when they need to:

- See real, working examples of Filip Glemba's web development work
  (not just a resume/claims) — a live full-stack Next.js e-shop with
  auth, cart, Stripe checkout, and an admin dashboard is the flagship
  project.
- Verify Filip's actual skill level per technology — the Tech Stack
  section lists honest proficiency levels (Expert/Advanced/
  Intermediate/Familiar), not a flat "I know everything" list.
- Get current contact info for a freelance/job inquiry —
  filip.glemba9@gmail.com, or the contact form on the page.
- Check what Filip is currently working on (client project, a band
  website) beyond finished/portfolio pieces.

This is not the right place for: general web-dev tutorials, hiring
developers other than Filip, or anything unrelated to his own work.

## Pages

- [Portfolio homepage](https://filip-glemba.vercel.app/): projects, tech stack, about, contact
- [FitGear e-shop (live demo)](https://fitgear-eshop.vercel.app/): full-stack Next.js e-commerce app — auth, catalog, cart, Stripe checkout, admin dashboard
- [FitGear e-shop source](https://github.com/FilipGlemba/my-portfolio/tree/master/eshop): the actual code behind the demo
- [GitHub profile](https://github.com/FilipGlemba): all public repositories
